claim: test_diff_classification.md's C1–C11 call shapes (lines 263–324) all still read `CheckCompleteness(changes, specDir)` with no profile argument, while S15 in the same leaf (line 167) asserts "the completeness scenarios (C1–C11) likewise hold unchanged under the default profile" — a two-argument call shape cannot express a claim about which profile was passed.
authoritative_source: The arch's ## Interface section ("One call, over three inputs — the classified changes, the path to the spec directory, and the resolved profile") and the shipped signature `CheckCompleteness(changes []ClassifiedChange, specDir string, profile *schema.Profile) []DiffError` are the truth: CheckCompleteness takes three arguments. Commit 5db7915 already fixed the analogous staleness for Classify, adding a Setup bullet plus `defaultProfile` to every S7–S14 call shape, establishing the pattern this leaf should follow for C1–C11.
evidence: completeness_checker_test.go:124 (and the other TestREQ8_C1..C11 call sites) pass `schema.DefaultProfile()` as a required third argument, matching the shipped signature. The C1–C11 prose in test_diff_classification.md was left behind when the profile parameter was added — it still shows the pre-profile two-argument shape, contradicting both the current code and S15's own claim about what those scenarios hold unchanged under.
proposed_fix: Update every `CheckCompleteness(changes, specDir)` call shape in C1–C11 to `CheckCompleteness(changes, specDir, defaultProfile)`, and add a Setup bullet for the Completeness scenarios mirroring the Classify one: CheckCompleteness takes the resolved profile as a required third argument; `defaultProfile` stands for `schema.DefaultProfile()`, and every C1–C11 scenario passes it.
